strictFaithfulNote: faithful_strict is a post-hoc tightening, not in the preregistration: a faithful item is dropped if its text-layer stem or any option carries a digit token absent from the transcription (the recent Regents encoding of =, +, - as 5, 1, 2; lost minus signs; glued page numbers). Motivation: the pre-registered option score accepts max(token F1, character ratio) >= 0.9, and the character ratio admits a one-character digit substitution inside a long option string.
